name: Do I need to hire separate contractors for drywall, carpentry, and painting?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to hire separate contractors for drywall, carpentry, and painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: You do not need to hire multiple separate contractors if you work with a full-scope remodeling service. HH Remodeling LLC acts as a single point of contact for your entire interior project. The in-house crew directly handles framing, drywall installation and finishing, custom tile and marble, finish carpentry, and painting. For projects that require plumbing adjustments or electrical line alterations, the general contractor directly coordinates qualified trade partners. This saves you from having to manage overlapping schedules, misaligned timelines, or conflicting trade handoffs on your own.
acceptedAnswer.description: No. Working with a comprehensive contractor allows one crew to manage framing, drywall, tile, carpentry, and painting while directly coordinating any necessary plumbing or electrical sub-trades.
